name: U.S. Documents for Americans & Expats Living Abroad Resource Center
claim_limits: Never attribute national U.S.-citizen counts to a single city or hub.
Date-qualify every numeric American-resident claim (year or exact source date).
InterNations and similar rankings are survey popularity only — not census counts.
Tier C internal demand signals are never published as public metrics.
Nigeria, India, Pakistan, and Uzbekistan are excluded from this property's primary map.
Lebanon / Beirut is watchlist only — not a primary Gulf hub.

primary_hubs.info_gain: Capital hub with U.S. Mission presence; strong InterNations survey visibility labeled as survey-only.
